prompt:
A man of about fifty has stopped on his bicycle on a Berlin bicycle lane,
seen from the waist up, three quarters turned to his left, right of centre in
a vertical frame. He is HEAVY-SET AND BROAD-SHOULDERED, a
head shorter than a tall young man. His hair is SHORT, STRAIGHT AND STEEL
GREY, cut close at the sides; his beard is a close-cropped grey full beard;
he wears thin rimless glasses; his face is square, ruddy and weathered, with
deep lines at the eyes. A dark grey cycling helmet sits on his head, its
straps under the beard. He wears a BRIGHT YELLOW
waterproof cycling jacket, clearly visible, over dark trousers, and his
bicycle is dark grey. One foot is on the ground, both hands rest on the
handlebars. His face is annoyed and in control of it. Behind him the street
runs on with a plain pale building front and three or four black city bicycles leaning against the wall, well spaced. Daylight,
overcast and even. He looks at a point beyond the left edge of the frame and
does not face the camera.
